message.text:
Redesign the existing Bloomi mobile blood donation app, in Spanish, for Colombian donors. Implementable in the EXISTING Flutter app: preserve flows, flower logo concept and exact main red #DC3545, darker red #C82333, ink #2B3648, pale neutral #F7F8FA and white. Create exactly FOUR screens: donor Home, donation Centers, Rewards (Canjes), and Impact. All share the SAME four-tab navigation: Inicio, Centros, Canjes, Impacto, with proper active tab. No invented booking, appointments, maps, notifications or eligibility claims. Existing Home: flower bloomi wordmark, profile and logout actions, initial avatar, greeting, blood type, donation count and points, Buscar centros CTA, medical summary (medications, conditions, allergies; private), health questionnaire with saved/pending status. Centers: institution list with name, city, department and address; no booking. Rewards: point balance, catalogue items with icon/title/description/point cost, Canjear action or points-needed and claimed states. Impact: donation count and points, institution confirmation note; no unsupported lives-saved count. Use illustrative sample data only in the mockup, but avoid long invented datasets. Home is the visual anchor. Keep a recognizable donor dashboard structure but improve spacing, readability, and visual hierarchy substantially.
Style direction: reassuring, friendly, polished and quietly joyful, a blood-donation community rather than a generic fitness or banking app. The original blood red is the core brand and reserved for hero and primary actions; use very pale rose and cool white surfaces with navy slate text and restrained borders. Use a single rounded humanist sans family with warm, legible shapes, a clear scale, strong large greetings and comfortable 14-16px supporting text. Layout is left aligned, naturally scrollable and spacious, with main donor identity at top, compact impact summary, prominent next-step donation action, then practical health tools. Components use varied deliberate 12-24px corner radii, minimal shadows, and a clean accessible four-tab bar with icon and label. Use material-symbols icons where possible to preserve compatibility with existing Flutter Material icons. No photography, no stock images, no decorative gradients or all-caps labels. One distinctive floral detail connecting the Bloomi name with donor care, without clutter. Avoid identical card grids and oversized decorative metrics. Ensure all four screens look like one coherent existing app elevated by a mobile design studio.
